'''2010 Malastare Regionals Jonathan Murray DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jonathan Murray]] at [[2010 Malastare Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Jabba Love
* '''Username:''' Throdo
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
